staleness_warning: STALE. The spec self-reports generation on 2022-11-04 against order-service 2.4.0 (info.version). The repo is now at SERVER_VERSION 2.8.14 (build.gradle says 2.8.4 — the two disagree). The spec documents 30 paths / 45 operations; only 2 endpoints exist in today's source.
staleness_evidence: Spec info.description: 'springdoc-openapi 자동 생성. 생성일 2022-11-04.' and info.version '2.4.0' vs SERVER_VERSION '2.8.14'.

Only two @RestController classes exist: OrderController (POST /orders/{ordNo}/cancel) and OrderSearchController (GET /api/v1/orders/search). The spec's 28 other paths (/orders GET+POST, /orders/{ordNo}, /details, /history, /delivery, /payment, /hold, /release, /address, /memo, /split, /merge, all /partners/*, all /admin/*, all /internal/*) have no handler in the repo.
GET /api/v1/orders/search is NOT in the spec at all — the spec's admin search is POST /admin/orders/search.

Cancel semantics inverted since the spec was generated. SF-2287 (migration V8__add_cancel_event_outbox.sql, 2023-04-18) made settled orders cancellable; the legacy OrderCancelServiceV1 that rejected settled orders is @Deprecated since 2.8.0. Today's OrderCancelService blocks only CHWISO and BANPUM.

OrderStatus enum now has 7 values including GYEOLJE_WANRYO, SANGPUM_JUNBI and JUNGSAN_WANRYO; the 2022-generated client in delivery-bff (src/generated/orderApi.ts, generated 2022-11-08 from this very file) still has 5 values starting with JUMUN_WANRYO, which no longer exists.
springdoc-openapi is absent from build.gradle dependencies, so this file cannot be regenerated from the current code — it is frozen at 2022.

openapi.code-derived.json.note: This is the live-truth surface. Prefer it over openapi.json for anything current.

uncertainties: No git history in the fixture repos, so the usual git-log staleness comparison could not be run; staleness is argued from file content (spec self-reported generation date and version numbers).

No authentication is visible in the code at all — no Spring Security dependency, no filter, no @PreAuthorize. The 2022 spec declares a global bearerAuth scheme. Either auth was removed, or it is terminated at the gateway. Unresolved.
OrderSearchService's RowMapper returns null for every row, so GET /api/v1/orders/search returns a list of nulls. Either dead code or an unfinished refactor.
